def generate_sto3g_hamiltonian(mol, integrals):
    # Define STO-3G Hamiltonian matrix based on integrals
    h = np.zeros((mol.natom, mol.natom))
    for i, j, F, G in integrals:
        h[i, i] += F
        h[j, j] += F
        h[i, j] -= G / 2
    return h

def construct_sto3g_hamiltonian(molecule, integrals):
    return generate_sto3g_hamiltonian(molecule, integrals)

def build_qubit_registration(molecule):
    # Map atoms to qubits and construct qubit registration
    qubits = [qiskit.QuantumRegister(1, f"qbit_{atom.symbol}") for atom in molecule.atoms]

    for i, atom in enumerate(molecule.atoms):

    ansatz = qiskit.QuantumCircuit(*qubits)

    def create_rotation(qubit_index, angle):

        for _ in range(swap_count):

        for i in range(len(qubits) - 1):
